description: Index VALUATION for a China Securities Index Co. (CSI) or SSE index code: the latest trading day's P/E and dividend yield plus roughly the last 20 trading days, dated. Answers "CSI Dividend Index 000922 latest P/E and dividend yield", "SSE Dividend 000015 valuation", "H30269 dividend low volatility index P/E", "930955 红利低波100 市盈率 股息率", "中证红利指数估值". Returns four published figures per day: P/E1 (total shares), P/E2 (calculation shares), D/P1 (dividend yield on total shares, %) and D/P2 (dividend yield on calculation shares, %). NOT in this source, and never estimated: P/B (市净率) and valuation percentile / history rank (估值分位) -- the response lists them under not_provided. Code is case-sensitive upstream: numeric codes as 6 digits (000922, 000300, 930955), letter-prefixed ones with an upper-case letter (H30269). An unknown or unpublished code returns found:false. Source: China Securities Index Co., daily index indicators.

days.description: How many trading days of history to return, 1-30 (default: everything published, about 20).

index_code.description: CSI/SSE index code, e.g. "000922" (CSI Dividend), "000015" (SSE Dividend), "H30269" (CSI Dividend Low Volatility), "930955" (CSI Dividend Low Volatility 100), "000300" (CSI 300).
